description: A classic crewneck in 100% Grade A Mongolian cashmere, 2-ply, knit in our Portland, Maine workshop. Sizes XS to XL, true to size with a relaxed fit. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Hand wash cold or dry clean, dry flat, store folded with cedar. Customers rate it 4.9 stars and one wrote 'the softest thing I own'. Free returns within 60 days, unworn with tags. Ships in 2 to 4 business days. Register it and get 15% off your next order. We pay our knitters a living wage and the yarn is traceable to the herding cooperative.
